name: Capilano Golf and Country Club
architects: Stanley Thompson (opened 1937), for the Guinness family's British Pacific Properties

dtm.source: Natural Resources Canada HRDEM (CanElevation) DTM 1 m via the NRCan datacube WCS (datacube.services.geo.ca/ows/elevation, coverage dtm) in EPSG:32610, CGVD2013 m; lidar projects at the course BC-Vancouver_Island_Sunshine_Coast_2018 (2018-19) and BC-Lower_Mainland_2016; fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-capilano)

dsm.source: Natural Resources Canada HRDEM, the same projects, DSM 1 m (first-return surface), via the same WCS (coverage dsm)
dsm.label: lidar surface model (NRCan HRDEM)

scorecard_source: Third-party (no card on the club's site found): GolfPass (course 26797) per-hole par, men's handicap and Gold/Blue/White yardages, read 2026-11-13; every row adds up to the page's totals (Gold 6,723; Blue 6,448; White 6,187). Gold rating/slope 73.0/133 from the same page's tee table (printed there against 6,706 yd). allsquaregolf.com gives the same card in metres (hole 1 shorter). Unverified against a printed card.
attribution: Elevation and trees: contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada (Natural Resources Canada, HRDEM)
notes: Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1), 2026-11-13: the longest tee set (Gold) and it is the default; all water red; OB = the OSM course boundary, roads inside it are cart paths, the driving range is OB; wind 1-7 mph (inland Pacific Northwest: the course is cut through forest on the North Shore slope, sheltered from the sea); trees from the HRDEM surface model (DSM - DTM), trees in fairways or in the way of a centre-line drive removed and listed. Theme capilano (new; the course chat's design).

world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (647 x 1,912 m, way/96680026): 188 m of scenery west/east; north/south the world is held to the 2,048 m limit, so 68 m of scenery beyond each end of the boundary (the usual 120 m would make it 2,304 m tall)

green_tilt_note: 7 (290 m2): its random bumps left only two hole locations under 3 % (pins.test.ts); a gentler plane and no bumps, as COURSE_LESSONS says
